```{r}

# --- CREATE MODEL --- #

# Prepare data

data_for_analysis = data_for_analysis %>% 
  rename(dis_per = disturbance_percentage)

# Model

model <- glmmTMB(bioarea_mm2_per_ml ~
                   trophic_type * size * conn * dis_per + 
                   (1 | ecosystem_ID) +
                   (1 | day) +
                   (1 | baseline),
                 data = data_for_analysis,
                 family = tweedie(link = "log"),
                 dispformula = ~ day + trophic_type + dis_per)
```

<details>
<summary>Model residuals coding</summary>
```{r}

# --- CODE MODEL RESIDUALS --- #

emmeans_output = emmeans(model,
                         specs = ~  conn * dis_per * size * trophic_type,
                         adjust = "sidak",
                         bias.adj = TRUE,
                         lmer.df = "satterthwaite") 

emmeans_output

aut_uncon_decr_6_43 = c(1, rep(0,31)) 
aut_con_decr_6_43 = c(rep(0,1), 1, rep(0,30)) 
aut_uncon_fix_6_43 = c(rep(0,2), 1, rep(0,29)) 
aut_con_fix_6_43 = c(rep(0,3), 1, rep(0,28)) 
aut_uncon_decr_9 = c(rep(0,4), 1, rep(0,27))
aut_con_decr_9 = c(rep(0,5), 1, rep(0,26)) 
aut_uncon_fix_9 = c(rep(0,6), 1, rep(0,25)) 
aut_con_fix_9 = c(rep(0,7), 1, rep(0,24)) 
aut_uncon_decr_15 = c(rep(0,8), 1, rep(0,23))
aut_con_decr_15 = c(rep(0,9), 1, rep(0,22))
aut_uncon_fix_15 = c(rep(0,10), 1, rep(0,21))
aut_con_fix_15 = c(rep(0,11), 1, rep(0,20))
aut_uncon_decr_45 = c(rep(0,12), 1, rep(0,19))
aut_con_decr_45 = c(rep(0,13), 1, rep(0,18))
aut_uncon_fix_45 = c(rep(0,14), 1, rep(0,17))
aut_con_fix_45 = c(rep(0,15), 1, rep(0,16))

het_uncon_decr_6_43 = c(rep(0,16), 1, rep(0,15)) 
het_con_decr_6_43 = c(rep(0,17), 1, rep(0,14)) 
het_uncon_fix_6_43 = c(rep(0,18), 1, rep(0,13)) 
het_con_fix_6_43 = c(rep(0,19), 1, rep(0,12)) 
het_uncon_decr_9 = c(rep(0,20), 1, rep(0,11)) 
het_con_decr_9 = c(rep(0,21), 1, rep(0,10)) 
het_uncon_fix_9 = c(rep(0,22), 1, rep(0,9)) 
het_con_fix_9 = c(rep(0,23), 1, rep(0,8)) 
het_uncon_decr_15 = c(rep(0,24), 1, rep(0,7))
het_con_decr_15 = c(rep(0,25), 1, rep(0,6))
het_uncon_fix_15 = c(rep(0,26), 1, rep(0,5))
het_con_fix_15 = c(rep(0,27), 1, rep(0,4))
het_uncon_decr_45 = c(rep(0,28), 1, rep(0,3))
het_con_decr_45 = c(rep(0,29), 1, rep(0,2))
het_uncon_fix_45 = c(rep(0,30), 1, rep(0,1))
het_con_fix_45 = c(rep(0,31), 1)

n_of_digits = 3
contrasts = contrast(emmeans_output, 
                     method = list("Aut 6.43 ml decrease % with size" = aut_con_decr_6_43 - aut_uncon_decr_6_43,
                                   "Aut 9.00 ml decrease % with size" = aut_con_decr_9 - aut_uncon_decr_9,
                                   "Aut 15.00 ml decrease % with size" = aut_con_decr_15 - aut_uncon_decr_15,
                                   "Aut 45.00 ml decrease % with size" = aut_con_decr_45 - aut_uncon_decr_45,
                                   "Aut 6.43 ml fixed % with size" = aut_con_fix_6_43 - aut_uncon_fix_6_43,
                                   "Aut 9.00 ml fixed % with size" = aut_con_fix_9 - aut_uncon_fix_9,
                                   "Aut 15.00 ml fixed % with size" = aut_con_fix_15 - aut_uncon_fix_15,
                                   "Aut 45.00 ml fixed % with size" = aut_con_fix_45 - aut_uncon_fix_45,
                                   
                                   "Het 6.43 ml decrease % with size" = het_con_decr_6_43 - het_uncon_decr_6_43,
                                   "Het 9.00 ml decrease % with size" = het_con_decr_9 - het_uncon_decr_9,
                                   "Het 15.00 ml decrease % with size" = het_con_decr_15 - het_uncon_decr_15,
                                   "Het 45.00 ml decrease % with size" = het_con_decr_45 - het_uncon_decr_45,
                                   "Het 6.43 ml fixed % with size" = het_con_fix_6_43 - het_uncon_fix_6_43,
                                   "Het 9.00 ml fixed % with size" = het_con_fix_9 - het_uncon_fix_9,
                                   "Het 15.00 ml fixed % with size" = het_con_fix_15 - het_uncon_fix_15,
                                   "Het 45.00 ml fixed % with size" = het_con_fix_45 - het_uncon_fix_45)) %>% 
  as.data.frame() %>%
  mutate(p.value = round(p.value, digits = n_of_digits),
         estimate = round(estimate, digits = n_of_digits),
         SE = round(SE, digits = n_of_digits),
         df = round(df, digits = n_of_digits),
         t.ratio = round(z.ratio, digits = n_of_digits),
         e = "",
         e = ifelse(p.value > 0.1, 
                           "",
                           e),
         e = ifelse(p.value < 0.05, 
                           "*",
                           e),
         e = ifelse(p.value < 0.01, 
                           "**",
                           e),
         e = ifelse(p.value < 0.001, 
                           "***",
                           e)) %>%
  rename(" " = e)
```

<details open="open">
<summary>Model residuals</summary>
```{r fig.width = figures_height_rmd_output}

# --- PLOT MODEL RESIDUALS --- #

simulationOutput <- simulateResiduals(fittedModel = model, n = 1000)
testDispersion(simulationOutput)
plot(simulationOutput)

plotResiduals(simulationOutput, form = data_for_analysis$day)
plotResiduals(simulationOutput, form = data_for_analysis$size)
plotResiduals(simulationOutput, form = data_for_analysis$conn)
plotResiduals(simulationOutput, form = data_for_analysis$dis_per)
if(response_variable_selected == "bioarea_mm2_per_ml") {
  plotResiduals(simulationOutput, form = data_for_analysis$trophic_type)
  }

testOutliers(simulationOutput)
testZeroInflation(simulationOutput)
```
